concepts.angle: Real phone macro photo of a 'clean' denture with visible yellow film and a glass of murky water (gross macro, minimal text)
concepts.based_on: Curated inspiration (Oct 28): macro/gross real photo with one direct line (e.g. real tongue photo 'Say goodbye to bad breath in 7 days', top 1-4%); feedback 'You could still see food on the denture', 'denture lost its whiteness'
concepts.headline: You brush them. You soak them. This is still on them.
concepts.prompt: Unedited phone photo taken at a bathroom sink under a harsh vanity light: an older person's real hand (visible wrinkles, age spots, a plain wedding band) holds a set of upper dentures with natural pink acrylic gums, up close to the camera so yellow-brown film and stain in the tooth grooves and along the gum line is clearly visible; on the sink edge a glass of cloudy water with a dissolved blue tablet residue. Shallow natural focus, slightly imperfect framing. A plain white Inter SemiBold caption with a soft shadow across the lower third: "You brush them. You soak them. This is still on them." IMPORTANT: render ONLY the exact quoted words, spelled exactly; no other text anywhere, no logos, no competitor names. Typography: Inter (clean modern grotesque sans), never serif, script or rounded display fonts.
